---
applyTo:
  - "apps/web/**"
---

# Web rules

- Use React, TypeScript strict mode, Vite, and accessible semantic components.
- The web application edits drafts through the Context API; it never writes the store directly.
- Make environment, evidence source, confidence, and manifest version visible.
- Separate observed topology from declared intent visually.
- Copilot proposals require explicit review and approval.
- Meet WCAG AA expectations and support keyboard-only operation.
- Never render unrestricted raw log bodies.
